entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6593"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 94</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.94.1-Ps.94.23">Psa 94:1-23</reference>. The writer, appealing to God in view of the oppression of enemies, rebukes them for their wickedness and folly, and encourages himself, in the confidence that God will punish evildoers, and favor His people.</title> <div sID="gen10102" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6593"/>1-2. God's revenge is His judicial infliction of righteous punishment.<div eID="gen10102" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen10103" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">show thyself--</hi>(Compare Margin). <div eID="gen10103" type="x-p"/>
